task: Connect the frontend to rubric v2 through a shared versioned report contract and automatic compatibility checks.
nonGoals: Changing rubric scores, inference, password or usage limits; merging backend engine branch; deploying cloud resources; changing CI policy or agent workflow.

outcomes.description: Rubric v1 and v2 reports display recognized business-friendly tests, correct statuses and points, specific findings and supported recommendations; unsupported versions fail clearly.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen report fixtures and rendered report regression tests.

outcomes.description: Shared report catalog/contract is consumed by backend report serialization and frontend normalization; compatibility regression checks reject unknown IDs and malformed data.
outcomes.evidence: Contract producer/consumer integration tests and catalog coverage against both frozen rubrics.

outcomes.description: Password protection and usage safeguards remain intact.
outcomes.evidence: Existing backend access/usage regression tests and no cloud writes.

process.description: Commit plan before implementation; Terra agents implement separate scopes; independent review and hosted CI before merge.
process.evidence: Git history, recorded actual evaluation and PR checks.

styleEfficiency.description: Use additive versioned contract support, preserve legacy reports and limit changes to report integration.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Review diff and source-bound command records; no model calls.

exitTest.reason: This changes the application report data contract and presentation, not agent workflow, memory, portability or resumability. Existing exit smoke tests still run.
